correctness.rationale: For complex traceless 2x2 T=H+iK, writing traceless Hermitian parts as Pauli vectors gives ||H cos(theta)+K sin(theta)||_op^2=a cos^2(theta)+b sin^2(theta)+2c sin(theta)cos(theta), with F^2=2(a+b) and |det T|^2=(a-b)^2+4c^2 by Cayley–Hamilton. This is (F^2/4)(1+rho cos(2theta-phi)), rho=2|det T|/F^2<=1, proving the exact Lp angular formula for all real p>=1. Evenness plus strict concavity of t^(p/2) for p<2 and strict convexity for p>2 proves strict monotonicity in rho (except p=2), with sharp normal (rho=1) and nilpotent (rho=0) endpoints. The p=4 identity omega^4=F^4/16+|det T|^2/8 was independently checked for noncommuting Pauli parts a=6,b=13,c=1 (moment=775/8, F^2=38, |det|^2=53). This finite exact test does not prove all p.

value.rationale: A complete two-parameter exact classification for a natural operator radius, including sharp normal/nilpotent equality cases, a universal critical p=2 reversal and perturbative determinant response. The one-parameter family of nonnormal matrices is not covered by universal bounds; precise extremal data is useful when analyzing sharp Cartesian radius inequalities.

limitations: All-dimensional operator statements not claimed; complex 2x2 traceless and p finite >=1 only.
